run_craftassist_agent: run the CraftAssistAgent Minecraft bot with argparse options to connect to a server and start the agent loop
init_perception_modules: initialize low level, heuristic, and semantic segmentation perception modules for the CraftAssistAgent
init_controller_dialogue: initialize the NSPDialogueManager with interpreter and memory handlers for processing incoming chat
controller_step_chat: process incoming chat messages from players and route them through the dialogue manager
point_at_target: send a point command to highlight a 3D bounding box target in the Minecraft world
